summary: 2FAuth is a self-hosted web application designed to store two-factor authentication accounts and generate their respective security codes. It provides a centralised interface for managing time-based one-time passwords independently of mobile apps or proprietary cloud ecosystems. The project is implemented in PHP and distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: This is a suitable tool if you want to migrate your 2FA token management away from consumer-oriented phone apps and keep your authentication seeds on your own infrastructure.
watchOut: Hosting your own 2FA generator creates a single point of failure; if your server goes down or loses its data, you may lose access to all associated accounts unless you maintain separate offline backups of your recovery codes.
deployNotes: Deployment is typically handled via Docker, requiring persistent storage for database or configuration files to prevent data loss between container restarts. You will also need to place the instance behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
